about_ai_assistance: Developed with the assistance of Google AI Studio, Cursor, and Claude Code tools.
about_description: A collection of tools for network diagnosis and management, designed to simplify common tasks for system administrators.
about_features_list:
• Network Diagnostics: Continuous ping, Traceroute, and port scanning.
• Host Discovery: Local, remote, and custom network scanning.
• Quick Remote Actions: RDP, MSRA, and Wake-on-LAN (WOL).
• Remote Management (WinRM): System info, service and event log management, user activity analysis, shutdown/restart, and interactive shell.
• Credential Vault: Secure and encrypted session-based password manager.
• Host Management: Import/export lists (CSV), nicknames, and reordering.
welcome_intro: A powerful and intuitive suite of tools to simplify your daily tasks.
